page: Hetzner Cloud cx43 is a shared-resource virtual server configured within the Cost Optimized family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and virtualized via QEMU, the instance is powered by an AMD EPYC processor running at a base frequency of 2.0 GHz. It offers 8 shared vCPUs mapped across 8 physical cores without multithreading, supported by 32 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity sits at 16.0 GB of RAM, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation (approximately 1.95 GB per core). For local persistence, the instance bundles 160 GB of NVMe SSD storage, while discrete GPU acceleration is not present.

Benchmark data reflects performance consistent with shared AMD EPYC compute resources. The cx43 demonstrates moderate throughput across parallel workloads, registering a Geekbench multi-core score of 5615.0, a stress-ng multi-core result of 20252.78, and a PassMark CPU score of 15774.82. However, single-threaded throughput is comparatively modest, indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 1143.0 and a single-threaded gzip compression speed of 23.39 GB/sec. Memory subsystems sustain solid throughput, reaching 89.3 GB/sec in large-block read operations and 62.62 GB/sec in large-block write operations, which aids in-memory workloads like Redis SET operations reaching 14.46 million operations per second.

From an infrastructure perspective, the cx43 offers dense core allocations paired with NVMe storage at shared-tier cost efficiency. The trade-off centers on core sharing and modest per-thread clock frequencies, alongside the lack of advanced instruction sets like AVX-512 or AMX. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given these operational parameters, the cx43 is well matched for horizontally scalable microservices, CI/CD build agents, software compilation tasks, moderate database instances, and static web serving, while high-demand single-threaded or low-latency enterprise applications will face resource limitations.
description: Hetzner Cloud cx43 is an x86_64 virtual server from the Cost Optimized tier, powered by an AMD EPYC processor operating at 2.0 GHz. It features 8 shared vCPUs, 16.0 GB of system memory, and 160 GB of bundled NVMe SSD storage, without GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. System benchmarks highlight average multi-threaded capabilities, yielding a PassMark CPU score of 15774.82 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 5615.0, balanced against lower single-thread execution efficiency. Memory read throughput reaches 89.3 GB/sec on large uncached blocks, supporting static web throughput of 10.98 GB/sec and 14.46 million Redis SET operations per second. The cx43 is best suited for budget-conscious compute workloads, multi-threaded batch jobs, software compilation, CI/CD runners, and secondary database services.
